allOf.title: response/version
allOf.description: Response bodies must be a UTF-8 encoded JSON object and must minimally include the MDS `version`.

version.title: data-type/version
version.description: The version of MDS this data represents.

links.description: If pagination is used for endpoints that support it, the pagination must comply with the [JSON API](http://jsonapi.org/format/#fetching-pagination) specification.

first.title: The URL to the first page of data.

last.title: The URL to the last page of data.

prev.title: The URL to the previous page of data.

next.title: The URL to the next page of data.

last_updated.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the data in this feed was updated.
last_updated.title: data-types/timestamp

ttl.description:
Integer representing the number of milliseconds before the data in this feed will be updated again
(0 if the data should always be refreshed). The data returned by a near-realtime endpoint should be as close to realtime
as possible, but in no case should it be more than 5 minutes out-of-date.
ttl.title: data-types/integer-positive

device_id.description: A unique device ID in UUID format.
device_id.title: data-types/uuid

provider_id.description: A UUID for the Provider, unique within MDS. See MDS [provider list](https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/main/providers.csv).
provider_id.title: data-types/uuid

data_provider_id.description: If different than `provider_id`, a UUID for the data solution provider managing the data feed in this endpoint.
data_provider_id.title: data-types/uuid

vehicle_id.description: A unique vehicle identifier (visible code, license plate, etc), visible on the vehicle itself.
vehicle_id.title: data-types/string

propulsion_types.description: The type of propulsion; allows multiple values.
propulsion_types.title: data-types/propulsion-type-array

items.title: data-types/propulsion-type
items.description: The allowed types of propulsion in MDS. Based off of `propulsion_type` in [GBFS vehicle_types](https://github.com/MobilityData/gbfs/blob/master/gbfs.md#vehicle_typesjson)

battery_capacity.description: Capacity of battery expressed as milliamp hours (mAh).
battery_capacity.title: data-types/integer-positive

fuel_capacity.description: Capacity of fuel tank (liquid, solid, gaseous) expressed in liters.
fuel_capacity.title: data-types/integer-positive

maximum_speed.description: Maximum speed (kph) possible with vehicle under normal, flat incline, smooth surface conditions. Applicable if the device has a built-in or intelligent speed limiter/governor.
maximum_speed.title: data-types/integer-positive

accessibility_attributes.description: The accessibility options available on a given vehicle. Required if available.
accessibility_attributes.title: modes/micromobility/accessibility-attributes

year.title: data-types/minimum-year
year.description: Represents a minimum for fields that capture a year as an integer. Derived from Unix timestamp 0.
